scope: Static declarations and synthetic configuration narrowing; no inference

properties.description: Qwen3-ASR 1.7B using locally converted Core ML models targeting ANE.

config_schema.description: Standard ASR cache defaults, with explicit paths for existing local bundles.

allow_private_urls.description: Opt-in to relax the SSRF policy so an AudioUrl may target a private/loopback/link-local address (HTTPS is still required). False by default; set True only for a trusted internal endpoint.
allow_private_urls.title: Allow Private Urls

download_root.description: Root directory for downloaded inference artifacts.
download_root.title: Download Root

model_dir.description: Bundle path; defaults to the selected profile in the Standard ASR cache.
model_dir.title: Model Dir

source_dir.description: Where `standard-asr pull` keeps the pinned official checkpoint it converts from; reused when present.
source_dir.title: Source Dir

use_draft.description: Enable the optional GPU draft using its managed cache path.
use_draft.title: Use Draft

draft_source_dir.description: Pinned 0.6B checkpoint cache, used by explicit draft acquisition.
draft_source_dir.title: Draft Source Dir

draft_dir.description: Optional draft bundle from `qwen3-asr-ane build-draft`. When set, batch transcription proposes tokens with Qwen3-ASR 0.6B on the GPU and verifies them on the Neural Engine; output is unchanged. Needs the gpu-draft extra.
draft_dir.title: Draft Dir

draft_bits.description: In-memory quantization of the draft decoder; None keeps bf16.
draft_bits.title: Draft Bits

use_batching.description: Acquire a compact head for packed offline requests.
use_batching.title: Use Batching

use_alignment.description: Enable explicitly acquired Qwen forced alignment on the CPU.
use_alignment.title: Use Alignment

alignment_dir.description: Managed forced-aligner model and isolated runtime directory.
alignment_dir.title: Alignment Dir

use_diarization.description: Enable explicitly acquired speaker diarization on the CPU.
use_diarization.title: Use Diarization

diarization_dir.description: Directory containing the pinned segmentation and speaker-embedding models.
diarization_dir.title: Diarization Dir

config_schema.title: Qwen3ASRConfig

provider_params_schema.description: Per-request decoding budget; omitted values use the engine's defaults.

disable_draft.description: Use the ANE target without a configured GPU draft for this request.
disable_draft.title: Disable Draft

include_metrics.description: Include native timings, token IDs and raw decoder output in result.extra.
include_metrics.title: Include Metrics

provider_params_schema.title: Qwen3ASRParams
